title: Bill Ray's remote viewing of Buddha

tellings.quote: >> uh they uh Bill Ray I know they had him uh remote view Buddha and that was a uh change life-changing experience for him

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who worked in the military's remote viewing unit, says the unit had a colleague named Bill Ray remote view the Buddha in the 1980s. Remote viewing means trying to see faraway places, people or events using only the mind. Buchanan says it was a life-changing experience for Ray, which, if true, would suggest the mind can reach across time as well as distance.
